description: This file defines the Toaster class which provides static methods to display success and error toast messages using the Toasty library within an Android app.

classes.name: Toaster
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to show customized toast messages for success and error notifications.

methods.name: successToast
methods.description: Displays a success toast with a check icon and specified message.

methods.name: errorToast
methods.description: Displays an error toast with an error icon and specified message.
